blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has issued new guidelines clarifying for covered taxpayers the procedures for complying with the requirements of its Enhanced Electronic Documentary Stamp Tax (eDST) System. According to a BIR statement issued on Wednesday, the guidelines are contained in Revenue Memorandum Circular (RMC) No. 107-2026, which was published on Oct. 1. They provide clearer procedures for enrolling in the system and using it, and for resolving common compliance issues. “The Enhanced eDST System gives covered taxpayers a secure and standardized electronic way to affix documentary stamps and comply with their DST obligations.
